run_gmock_gen: run gmock_gen.py on a C++ header file to generate Google Mock class stubs to stdout
run_gmock_class: run gmock_class.py on a C++ header file to generate mock classes for specified class names
generate_mock_methods: generate MOCK_METHOD macros for all virtual non-ctor/dtor methods in a C++ class
generate_mock_class: generate a MockClassName class that extends a given C++ base class with mocked virtual methods
parse_cpp_ast: parse a C++ source file into an AST and extract class and function nodes for mock generation
